notes.title: We're being funded by Outersloth!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone! [/p][p]It's been a while since our last post here, as we're still working hard on the production of [i]Am I Nima[/i], but we're very excited to share a few things with you today![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216586/52060cfb9883a246598583d7b2ab439dfcfa4f9d.png"][/img][/p][p]First of all, we'd like to announce that [b][i]Am I Nima[/i] will be funded by Outersloth![/b] We're very grateful to their team for believing in us and our game, and for allowing us the chance to make Am I Nima the best game it can be. With this funding we'll be able to do things that we wouldn't have been able to do, including:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Localization support for nine more languages! [/b]We're happy to announce that the full release of [i]Am I Nima[/i] will feature support for English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Brazilian Portuguese, French, German, and European Spanish. [/p][p]It's been so amazing to see people from around the world enjoy the [i]Am I Nima[/i] demo, so we hope we can bring the game to even more people when the game comes out![/p][p][/p][p]Lastly, we just wanted to say thank you for all of your continued support. As of now, [b][i]Am I Nima[/i] has been wishlisted by more than 84,000 people! [/b]We are truly humbled by the reception we've gotten and are amazed everyday by the incredible fanart, videos, and community enthusiasm we see. [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you everyone for your patience as we continue to work away on our game, and we hope to show you guys more things soon![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216586/c81417ef32db5dd38c65923510de2e832fe07891.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update 1.00.03
notes.content:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Title screen fix for users reporting that the only the background image was appearing
[*] Added a Mac Build (currently built to 1.00.02)
[/list]

Dev Blurb:
A temporary fix of pressing "Enter" on the title screen will additionally start the game for now. Please let me know if there are still issues reaching the game. (Might need a fresh install on Steam)

- Alvin (Lead Programmer)

notes.title: Demo Update 1.00.02
notes.content:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Added FPS options in Visual Settings
[*] Fixed typos in Words and Story
[*] Pause Menu has been partially revamped and properly remembers options
[*] Fix volume controls issue at 0
[*] Fix Resolution option not being clickable
[*] Add versioning to main menu and pause
[*] Compressed game to be much smaller than before
[/list]

Dev Blurb:
Thank you everyone for all the support and reports! It has been amazing seeing all the art, theories, suggestions and discourse about the game! You guys rock!!!

The focus for the next update will be: 
[list]
[*] Save Functionality
[*] Further investigation on game breaking bugs
[*] A proper credits page
[/list]

- Alvin (Lead Programmer)
